content: Yesu ziru Nikodemus tiso sua
Tomtom tutu kana ta, ni zaana Nikodemus. Mi kaunsil biibi ta tikamam peeze pizin Yuda na, ni zaana imbot la tomini.

Mbeŋ ta na, ni ila ki Yesu, mi iso pini ta kembei: “O mos katuunu, niam amute: Nu, Anutu iŋgo u ma mar be paute zin tomtom. Pa sombe Anutu ilae ki tomtom som, na ni irao be itooro mos boozomen kembei ta nu kamam na som.”
Mi Yesu ipekel kwoono ma iso: “Nio aŋso kat pu ta kembei: Bela tomtom iwe popoŋana,
tona ni irao be ire peeze ki Anutu.”

Mi Nikodemus ipekel ma iso: “Wae. Sua ku tina, nio aŋkankaana pa ka uunu. Tomtom ta sombe iwe kolman kek, nako irao be iwe popoŋana mini be parei? Ko tomtom sa irao be itoori ma ilela naana kopoono be ipeebi mini?”
Yesu ipekel kwoono ma iso: “Nio aŋso kat pu ta kembei: Bela tomtom iwe popoŋana pa yok raama Bubuŋana, tona ni irao be imbot la peeze ki Anutu mi ilela kar kini.
Koroŋ ta tomtom toono kan tipiyooto na, koroŋ ki toono. Mi koroŋ ta Bubuŋana ipiyooto na, koroŋ ki Bubuŋana.
Kokena nu murur pa sua ta aŋso pu ma aŋsombe: Bela Anutu itooro yom ma kewe popoŋoyom.

Re. Miiri zalaana ta imbot ki parei mi imar, mi imap su swoi na, iti tuute som. Pa ni itoto itunu zalaana men. Mi iti tarao be tere miiri som. Teleŋ men kalŋaana mi tikilaala. Mi ina raraate men pa uraata ta Anutu Bubuŋana ikamam pizin tomtom be itooro zin ma tiwe popoŋan na.”
Nikodemus ileŋ sua tana to iso: “Wai, mbulu tina ko ipet be parei?”
Mi Yesu ipekel kalŋaana ma iso: “Wae! Zin Israel tire u kembei nu zom biibi pa uraata ki pauteŋana. Parei ta su mini, mi so nu kankaana pa sua tio ti?
Nio aŋso kat pu ta kembei: Koroŋ ta niam amute, ta amzzo pa. Pa niam amre kat pa motoyam. Tanata ampombolmbol ka sua. Tamen niom kakan la sua tiam som.
Iŋgi aŋso sua pa mbulu ta iwedet su toono, mi tamen niom kuurla som. Tana sombe aŋso pa koroŋ saamba kana, nako kuurla be parei? Som.
Asiŋ isala kar saamba kek bekena ire mi iso ka sua? Tomtom sa som. Tomtom Lutuunu itutamen ta imbot kar saamba mi isu.

Muŋgu Mose iurpe mooto kunuunu ta, mi iur sala ke ma ipamender. Beso tomtom tire la pa, to timeete som. Ina raraate pa Tomtom Lutuunu. Bela tiuri sala ke mi tipamenderi, tona wal boozomen ta so tiurla kini mi tisekapkap la kini, nako tikam mbotŋana ki Anutu ta iseeŋge iseeŋge ma ila.

“Pa Anutu, ni iur kat leleene pizin tomtom toono kan. Tanata iŋgo Lutuunu tamen ŋonoono ma isu pizin. Mi sombe tiurla kini, nako tisaana ma tila len som. Som kat. Zin ko tikam mbotŋana ki Anutu ta iseeŋge iseeŋge ma ila.
Pa Anutu, ni iŋgo Lutuunu ma isu toono taiŋgi be ipamender zin tomtom ma iur kadoono pizin na som. Ni iŋgo i ma isu bekena ikamke zin.

Tana tomtom ta sombe iurla ki Anutu Lutuunu, inako Anutu ipamenderi ma iur kadoono pini na som. Tamen sombe tomtom sa iurla kini som, na ni kembei tomtom tau zin bibip titiiri sua kini ma imap kek mi izza men be ikam le kadoono. Paso, ni iurla ki Anutu Lutuunu tamenŋana som.
Sombe Anutu iur kadoono pizin tomtom, nako ka uunu ta kembei: Mat ta isu toono kek. Tamen tomtom mbulu kizin ta boozomen isaana lup. Tana lelen pa mat tana som, mi lelen pa zugut ilip.
Pa wal boozomen ta tikamam mbulu sananŋana na, tiurur koi pa mat mi timbotmbot molo pa. Kokena mat iswe mbulu kizin.
Mi zin tau titoto sua ŋonoono ka mbulu na, lelen be timar ma timbot la mat leleene. Paso, mat izzwe zin kembei Anutu ta ipombolmbol zin ma tikamam mbulu tana.”
Yoan iswe kat Yesu uunu
Yesu ziŋan zin naŋgaŋ kini timbotmbot, mi kaimer to tizem Yerusalem, mi tila ma tiwwa pa lele pakaana ki Yudea. Timbotmbot tana, mi ni ikamam yok pizin tomtom.
Mi Yoan tomini ikamam yok pizin tomtom isu kar Aenon ta igarau pa kar Salim na. Pa lele tana na ka yokŋana. Mi tomtom boozo timokorkor lala kini be ikam yok pizin.
Indeeŋe tana, Erot iur Yoan ilela ruumu sanaana zen.
Aigule ta na, naŋgaŋ pakan ki Yoan ziŋan tomtom ta, tiparzorzooro pa weŋana ka tutu.

To tila ki Yoan mi tiso pini ta kembei: “Mos katuunu o, re. Tomtom ta muŋgu niomru kombotmbot Yordan pakaana mbaaga, mi nu pombol zin tomtom be tiurla kini, ta zin iwal timap ma tilala kini ma ikamam yok pizin a.”
Mi Yoan ipekel kwon ma iso: “Ambai. Mbulu ta kembeia irao ipet sorok na som. Anutu ipombolmboli, ta ni ikamam a.
Motoyom iŋgal. Muŋgu ituyom kombotmbot, mi keleŋ sua ta aŋso piom ma aŋso: Nio Mesia som. Nio na, Anutu iŋgo yo ma aŋmuuŋgu be aŋurpe zaala pini men.”

To Yoan ikam sua tooroŋana ti ise ki ni ziru Yesu. Iso: “Sombe tomooto sa iwoolo, na moori tana iwe lene. Mi sombe ula kizin ipet na, tomooto toroono ta iurpe zaala pa ula kizin na, ni leleene ndabok. Paso, uraata kini ta iur ŋonoono ma ziru tiwoolo kek. Mi nio ta kembena, leleŋ ndabok kat.
Yesu, ni zaana be izalla ma iwe biibi. Mi nio zoŋ, inabe izzu.”
Tomtom ta imbot saamba mi isu
Yoan, ni tomtom ki toono men. Paso ni ipet pa toono taiŋgi. Tana ni irao iso pa koroŋ ki toono men. Mi ni ta imbot saamba mi isu na, ni ilip pa koroŋ ta boozomen.
Koroŋ ta tomtom saamba kana tana ire kat pa mataana mi ileŋ pa talŋaana, ta izzo pa. Tamen tomtom sa ikan la sua kini som.
Mi sombe tomtom sa ikan la sua kini, na iswe kembei ni iurla Anutu sua kini, ina sua ŋonoono.
Pa tomtom ta Anutu iŋgo i ma isu na, ni izzo Anutu kalŋaana. Mi Anutu ikam Bubuŋana pini na, irre ki som. Imap ma ise kini.
Tamaana, ni leleene pa Lutuunu, mi iur koroŋ ta boozomen ma imap ila namaana kek.

Tana tomtom ta sombe iurla ki Lutuunu, na ni ikam mbotŋana ki Anutu ta iseeŋge iseeŋge ma ila. Mi tomtom ta so izooro Lutuunu, nako ikam mbotŋana tana som. Som kat. Anutu kete malmalŋana ko imbotmbot se kini, mi iseeŋge iseeŋge ma ila.

footnotes.text: Zaala toro tabe totooro sua ti na ta kembei: “Bela mburaana kor kana itooro tomtom ma iwe popoŋana, tona ni irao be ire peeze ki Anutu.”
Zin Yuda len tutu boozo pa weŋana. Ka ŋgar ta kembei: Zin sombe tito tutu tana, nako tiwe ŋgeezeŋan pa Anutu mataana.
